entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received last week. I need to return a jersey I purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number to start?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero Jersey, delivered on December 24th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. It's just the wrong size for me. I ordered my usual size, but this jersey is just way too tight across the chest.

I understand completely, sometimes the fit can vary between styles. Not a problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return period. We can definitely process this for you. Would you like a full refund, or would you prefer an exchange for a larger size?

An exchange sounds perfect. I'd like to try the next size up. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and sending it back, is there any way you could offer a small credit or a discount code for my trouble?

I'm happy to set up that exchange for you. While our policy doesn't allow for credits on a standard size exchange, I can tell you that we cover all return shipping costs, and the new jersey will be sent out as soon as the original one is scanned by the shipping carrier.
I see. So no discount code at all? Even for a future purchase?

I'm afraid not for this type of return. However, I have processed the exchange. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label to send back the jersey that was too tight. It’s a very simple process.
Alright, fair enough. As long as the exchange is straightforward. Thanks for your help.
You're most welcome. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day!
